description: Date-level PROGRAM (ad-attributed, per-click-timestamp CONVERTED conversions/sales) vs SITE (organic, monetize_merchant_facts converted) funnel for a marketplace, one row per date. Program side: spend, clicks, program_orders, program_gmv, program_viewproducts, program_add2carts. Site side: site_orders, site_revenue, site_viewproducts, site_add2carts. organic_orders = site_orders - program_orders. Money is converted to the marketplace currency. Filter by channel to isolate PLA (os_product_ads) vs Display (guaranteed_display_ads / auction_display_ads) on the program side.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.spend ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Program (advertising) spend on this date, converted to the marketplace currency.

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)
clicks.description: Program ad clicks on this date.

program_orders.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.program_orders ELSE 0 END), 0)

program_gmv.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.program_gmv ELSE 0 END), 0)
program_gmv.description: Ad-attributed GMV / sales on this date (per-click-timestamp CONVERTED sales), converted to the marketplace currency.

program_viewproducts.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.program_viewproducts ELSE 0 END), 0)

program_add2carts.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.program_add2carts ELSE 0 END), 0)

site_orders.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN s.site_orders ELSE 0 END), 0)
site_orders.description: Total site (organic) completed orders on this date (total_sok_salecompletes).

site_revenue.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN s.site_revenue ELSE 0 END), 0)
site_revenue.description: Total site (organic) revenue on this date (total_sok_sales_usd), converted to the marketplace currency.

site_viewproducts.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN s.site_viewproducts ELSE 0 END), 0)
site_viewproducts.description: Total site (organic) product-page views on this date (total_sok_viewproducts).

site_add2carts.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN s.site_add2carts ELSE 0 END), 0)

organic_orders.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN s.site_orders ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN p.program_orders ELSE 0 END), 0)

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM (SELECT cvcpf.date AS date, SUM(cvcpf.cost * scc.conversion_factor) AS spend, SUM(cvcpf.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(cvcpf.program_per_click_timestamp_conversions) AS program_orders, SUM(cvcpf.program_per_click_timestamp_sales) AS program_gmv, SUM(cvcpf.program_per_click_timestamp_viewproduct) AS program_viewproducts, SUM(cvcpf.program_per_click_timestamp_add_to_cart) AS program_add2carts FROM reporting.client_vendor_channel_performance_facts AS cvcpf INNER JOIN reporting.clients AS clients ON clients.client_id = cvcpf.client_id AND clients.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' INNER JOIN reporting.marketplace_clients AS mc ON mc.agency_id = clients.agency_id AND clients.client_id != mc.marketplace_client_id INNER JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc ON scc.from_currency = cvcpf.currency AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE cvcpf.vendor = 'os_ads' AND cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY 1) AS p FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT mmf.date AS date, SUM(mmf.total_sok_salecompletes) AS site_orders, SUM(mmf.total_sok_sales_usd * scc.conversion_factor) AS site_revenue, SUM(mmf.total_sok_viewproducts) AS site_viewproducts, SUM(mmf.total_sok_add2carts) AS site_add2carts FROM reporting.monetize_merchant_facts AS mmf INNER JOIN reporting.clients AS mc ON mmf.agency_id = mc.agency_id AND mmf.marketplace_client_id = mc.client_id INNER JOIN reporting.static_currency_conversion AS scc ON scc.from_currency = 'USD' AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE mmf.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND mmf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' GROUP BY 1) AS s ON p.date = s.date GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
